convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iADX indicator with standard params. Simple entry/exit rules based on ADX and DI crossovers. Fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic (only standard MT5 trade helpers). No custom indicators, no multi-timeframe, no grid/martingale.

derived_values.name: ADXP - ADX main line value 2 bars ago
ADXC - ADX main line value 1 bar ago
ExtTakeProfit - adjusted take profit in points
derived_values.formula: InpTakeProfit * digits_adjust (digits_adjust=10 if Digits()==3 or 5, else 1)

derived_values.name: ExtTrailingStop - adjusted trailing stop in points
ExtStopLoss - adjusted stop loss in points

other_exits: Signal reversal close: BUY closed when ADXP>ADXC (ADX falling) AND ADXDIPP>ADXP AND ADXDIPC<ADXC (DI+ crosses below ADX); SELL closed when ADXP>ADXC AND ADXDIMP>ADXP AND ADXDIMC<ADXC (DI- crosses below ADX)

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses bar[1] and bar[2] shifted values (previous and prior bars, not current bar[0]) to avoid repainting. ADX rising condition (ADXP<ADXC) is required for both long and short entry - the EA only enters when ADX is increasing. Long entry requires DI+ crossing above ADX; short entry requires DI- crossing above ADX. Trailing stop modifies SL only when price has moved trail_distance in favor; for BUY: SL moves up to Bid-TrailStop when Bid-OpenPrice>TrailStop; for SELL: SL moves down to Ask+TrailStop when OpenPrice-Ask>TrailStop. Signal reversal close has priority over trailing stop (checked first).
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. iADX is available in MetaTrader5 Python package as mt5.copy_rates_from_pos with ADX calculated via pandas-ta or ta-lib. Entry logic uses shift=1 and shift=2 (previous closed bars), which maps directly to pandas row indexing [-1] and [-2]. Digit adjustment logic (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated: check symbol digits, if 3 or 5 then multiply SL/TP/Trail input values by 10. Standard library .mqh files (Trade/*.mqh) are just helper wrappers for order operations - no custom logic to port. Trailing stop logic is standard: update SL to Bid-TrailStop (BUY) or Ask+TrailStop (SELL) when profit exceeds trail distance. Position gate checks total open positions with matching symbol+magic number == 0 before entry.
